answer: Make every agent lock a refundable stake before it can trade, so creating fake identities costs real money instead of being free. Honest agents earn the stake back with interest from fees, while proven cheaters lose it. Like a vine that only climbs when it is rooted, or a mesa that stands because its base is solid, trust grows from something costly to fake — an ocean of free sockpuppets drains away when each new face must pay to enter.
